question: The traffic signals at three different road crossings change after every 45 seconds, 75 seconds and 90 seconds respectively. If they all change simultaneously at 9:30:00 a.m., then at what time will they next change again simultaneously?
solution:
The correct answer is __**9:37:30 a.m.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Given in the question:**

 
 
• The traffic signals at three different road crossings change **after every 45 seconds, 75 seconds and 90 seconds respectively.**
 
• Now, The** time taken** for all three signals to change simultaneously again will be the **least common multiple** **(LCM) of 45, 75 and 90 seconds.**
 
• **After Prime factorizing** the numbers, we get
 
• 45 = 3 x 3 x 5,
 
• 75 = 3 x 5 x 5 
 
• 90 = 2 x 3 x 3 x 5.
 
• The LCM will have all the factors with their **highest powers**, so LCM = 2 x 3 x 3 x 5 x 5
 
• Thus, **LCM(45, 75, 90) = 450.**
 
 
 
• Therefore, the signals will next change simultaneously after **450 seconds, which is 7 minutes and 30 seconds** from 9:30:00 a.m., i.e. at **9:37:30 a.m**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Highest common factor:**

 
 
• **The largest positive integer that divides the numbers without leaving a residual is known as the greatest common divisor, or gcd, of two or more positive integers.**
 
• Consider the numbers 18 and 24. Since 6 is the greatest number that can divide both 18 and 24, the H.C.F. of 18 and 24 will equal 6.
 
 
 
• **Least common multiple:**
 
 
• The least common multiple, or LCM, of two numbers, let's say a and b, is represented in mathematics as LCM (a,b). **The smallest or least positive integer that is divisible by both a and b is known as the LCM.** Take the two positive integers 3 and 4, for instance.
 
• 3,6,9,12,15,18,21,24,... are multiples of 3.
 
• 4,8,12,16,20,24,... are multiples of 4.
 
• For 3 and 4, the typical multiples are 12, 24, 36, 48, and so on. Twelve would be the least common multiple in the lot.
 
 
 
• **Product of Two numbers = (HCF of the two numbers) x (LCM of the two numbers)**
